info.title: dotnet-apl
info.description: The dotnet tool for the ArchPillar.Extensions.Localization family: extract the source template from a built assembly and add, sync, or convert translation catalogs on demand.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Create a new language catalog for a template or across a scope

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --project
options.description:
A project (.csproj or its
directory); defaults to
the current directory

options.name: --solution
options.description:
A solution (.sln/.slnx or
its directory); defaults
to the current directory

options.name: --recurse
options.description:
Include the transitively
referenced projects of
the scope

options.name: --source
options.description:
en         The source language the
in-code defaults are
written in (default: en)

options.name: --assembly
options.description:
A single built assembly
to read, instead of
discovering a scope

options.name: --input
options.description:
A directory of built
assemblies to read

options.name: --no-annotations
options.description:
Extract only IL call
sites, omitting the [
Localized…] attribute
strings

options.name: --references
options.description:
Record the source files
each string is used in
(needs a PDB); off by
default
each project (default:
Translations)

options.name: --catalog-path
options.description:
The catalog folder inside
each project (default:
Translations)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Write every catalog into
this one directory
instead, relative to the
current directory; wins
over --catalog-path
